verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a spending cap, budget limit, or usage/credit alert for proxy or platform consumption. The only related items are adjacent: monitoring alerts for Actor performance and data quality (apify-docs-7), and a per-run maxCrawlPages input parameter (apify-docs-15). Neither is a budget control, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set a spending cap or usage alert so proxy/credit consumption doesn't silently blow past my budget
